formulas.name: Brownian Motion Increment
formulas.conditions: Independent of the path up to time s.
formulas.whenToUse: Computing probabilities or moments involving Brownian motion.
formulas.commonMistake: Forgetting the increment's variance is t-s, not t.

formulas.name: Covariance of Brownian Motion
formulas.whenToUse: Computing joint moments of Brownian motion at two times.
formulas.commonMistake: Using s+t or st instead of min(s,t).

formulas.name: Ito's Isometry / Key Rule
formulas.conditions: This is a heuristic rule made rigorous via quadratic variation.
formulas.whenToUse: Deriving Ito's formula and any stochastic calculus computation.
formulas.commonMistake: Treating (dB)^2 as negligible, as in ordinary calculus.
